u1223.note: The source’s causal account centers on concealed banking-family control of modern monetary history. The specific Federal Reserve ownership/control premise conflicts with its statutory governance and nonordinary member-bank stock. This materially unsupported causal core supports V1 at moderate confidence; no claim to a complete primary-text audit is made.
